from collections import Counter
def diff_summary(t):
    ab=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); aa=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if ab[r][c]!=aa[r][c]: cnt[(ab[r][c],aa[r][c])]+=1
    return dict(cnt)
res = action(['SPACE'])
print("SPACE:", diff_summary(last_transition), {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
</parameter>
